correctness.rationale: For the precise iid uniform single-attempt antagonistic adsorption model, the unique two-component protected-boundary Volterra system yields h_A,h_B. The accepted AA and BB pair events factor across disjoint exterior half-lines to give a^2,b^2. Adjacent unlike accepted labels are prohibited. Using independently reconstructed one-site probabilities R_A=p∫h_A² and R_B=q∫h_B², a derivative identity proves R_A+R_B=a+b-ab and hence P(XX)=(1-a-b)², closing the complete 3x3 matrix. Strict R_A<a,R_B<b yield positive like-species covariance; a<pt<=p,b<qt<=q make the factor 2(1-a)(1-b)-ab strictly positive, proving negative aggregate-occupation covariance. All quantifiers, boundaries and time normalization are explicit in RESULT.md. Packaged CHECK.py passed 147 assertions including independent finite-ring deposition simulation and exhaustive 5-,6-,7-site enumeration; numerical checks are not relied upon for the infinite analytic proof.

originality.rationale: The closest exact same-process primary full text, do Amaral and dos Santos arXiv:2306.09786v1, establishes single-site densities for the one-shot two-color process, not an adjacent-pair joint law or opposite-sign covariance theorem. Its cavity-event technique is acknowledged as a key antecedent. arXiv:2210.05627v1 computes the pair law for single-species nearest-neighbor exclusion, whose adjacent occupied events are all forbidden. arXiv:2211.04622v1 treats repeated-attempt antagonistic RSA and discusses one-dimensional three-site approximations, with a different generator. The new pair-matrix and strict parameter-wide coexistence of positive species and negative occupation covariances are not derived by merely reading the prior density expression. Actual published-record and primary-literature searches supplied no exact matching statement; a broad unpublished or overlooked RSA correlation specialization remains possible, and this self-review is not independent scholarly priority validation.

value.rationale: Natural adjacent-site A/B/X joint frequencies quantify domains, species-resolved clustering and vacancy contacts in a lattice deposition experiment, none determined by the source one-point densities. Exact elementary expressions for all nine probabilities over the entire parameter and observation-time ranges remove dependence on finite-size simulations. The strict structural paradox—same-species nearest-neighbor attraction coexisting with total-occupation repulsion—warns that uncolored imaging conceals species-specific clustering. The result is non-arbitrary, not merely a normalization identity, and covers a genuine spatial correlation gap in the exact same 2023 model.
